answer: Sybil attackers often skip forging clones and simply rent aged agent identities to swing governance. Receipt-free ballots kill that market: each agent votes encrypted through a coordinator and may secretly re-key and overwrite its choice before the tally, so a renter can never verify a bought vote. Paying for one is like buying pigment brushed on basalt before a gale: the color you saw can quietly wash off, so rented identities stop being worth anything.
